description: Submit a deal for the acting person (X-OV-Subject): a link, title and what the person sees now (price with its currency, shipping, condition, availability — each optional, never defaulted). The first observation is recorded with its time. A link already posted answers 409 offer.duplicate with the existing offer. With X-OV-Origin: ai the text is AI-assisted: disclosed and noindex until a person reviews it. Rate-limited per person.
